amendments.reason: Governed additive widening for the remaining delivery classes (best_effort, transaction_critical, policy_critical).
Governed additive widening for the one delivery adapter the governed inventory approves: createFetchHttpExchange over the runtime's fetch.

Governed additive widening for the HTTP audit sink: createHttpAuditSink and HttpAuditSinkOptions (#589), and HttpAuditSinkOutcome (#590, recorded in this same amendment as ADR-NODE-004 provides), the core's sink interface over the governed fetch delivery adapter, classified by the response classifier it shares with createHttpDeliveryHandoff.

Governed widening of two public unions without a new export (#859, #860): DeliveryClassRefusalCode gains business_commit_unconfirmed and audit_durability_failed_after_commit, and TransactionCriticalDeliveryResult gains the durable_without_commit status, so transaction-critical delivery claims only what it checks.

Governed widening of the TransactionCriticalDeliveryResult public union without a new export (#869): gains partially_committed_and_durable and compensated_and_durable statuses so transaction-critical delivery claims match partial and compensated commit states truthfully.

Governed widening of the DeliveryClassRefusalCode public union without a new export (#913): gains commit_state_not_allowed and occurrence_not_serializable, so transaction-critical delivery refuses, before the durability probe, an occurrence whose commit state its own catalog entry does not allow or that has no JSON serialization.
